description.value:
Your drone's frame and integrated weapon systems are calibrated to receive real-time overrides through your Mechanic Modify action. The drone counts as armor for Modify targeting, and its unarmed attacks count as weapons.

When the Mechanic's Killbot Modify is active, the drone gains a status bonus to damage equal to +2 per weapon damage die.

At 5th level, Modify can change the damage type of the drone's unarmed or mounted weapon Strikes to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. These effects need the Mechanic's linked Modify action to target and resolve the drone, so the toggle below is a roll-option marker rather than an automatic damage modifier.
